youtube_title: Jesus... I Said Yes Again When I Wanted To Say No | Galatians 1:10 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... I said yes again. I didn't want to. I never do.

She said yes again when she wanted to say no, and gave up her one free evening.

Her: Jesus... I said yes again. I didn't want to. I never do.

Her: My cousin asked me to cover for her tonight. Now I'm giving up my one free evening.

Jesus: You said yes so she would keep liking you. But you're tired of being liked only for being useful.

Her: If I say no, she'll be upset. Everyone will say I've changed.

Jesus: Maybe you have. Growing is allowed. The people who really love you can handle hearing no.

Her: But what if they can't? What if I end up with nobody?

Jesus: Then you'll find out who loved you, and who only loved your yes. I'm not going anywhere.

"Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ."
Galatians 1:10 (NIV)

Jesus: You don't have to earn your place by disappearing.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.
